architecture.control_plane: Dedicated Docker Executor Control-Plane Service (thinkdome-docker-executor) running on internal network port 8200.
architecture.public_api: Stateless FastAPI (thinkdome-api) communicating strictly with the executor service via authenticated internal RPC/HTTP REST endpoints.
architecture.task_workers: Stateless RabbitMQ consumers (thinkdome-worker) communicating strictly with the executor service via authenticated internal RPC/HTTP REST endpoints.

trust_boundaries.dind_credentials: Docker-in-Docker TLS certificates (dind-certs) are mounted EXCLUSIVELY into the thinkdome-docker-executor container. Neither API nor worker services receive Docker TLS certs, sockets, or direct Docker API access.
trust_boundaries.service_authentication: Mandatory X-Executor-Auth token / HMAC authentication on all internal control plane operations.
trust_boundaries.server_side_authorization: Server-side tenant_id, owner, and sandbox label validation on every operation to prevent cross-tenant and cross-sandbox access.

resolved_findings.title: Docker client TLS certificate volume is shared with API/workers
resolved_findings.evidence: API and worker services no longer mount dind-certs:/certs:ro. Mount is strictly isolated to thinkdome-docker-executor service.
resolved_findings.remediation: Implemented dedicated Docker Executor Control-Plane Service (thinkdome-docker-executor) with service-to-service authentication and server-side tenant/owner authorization.

remaining_risks: Production requires runtime verification of the externally managed rootless/hardened Docker daemon configured by EXECUTOR_DOCKER_HOST; the embedded rootless-DIND configuration was removed after runtime startup failure.

evidence.compose_verification: Verified docker-compose.prod.yml contains dind-certs mount ONLY under thinkdome-docker-executor.
evidence.pytest_suite: 43 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped in tests/security/docker with RUN_DOCKER_SECURITY_LIVE=1.
